label: Drawn
feel: 2D hand-drawn cartoon at 128 texels a metre: smooth shapes with thick dark ink, soft edges, bright flat colour, squashy characters with big expressions. Seen side-on by default, read like a cartoon panel.

three.notes: a side-on stage of platforms and ledges (gf-tilemap-1)

godot.notes: side-on stages and fields seen from above (gf-tilemap-1 read from slots); this kind's Godot look is side-on, so a field keeps the runtime's own background

bodies.notes: 6-frame body sheets baked from the platformer pack's poses (idle, walk a, walk b, jump, hit, duck), judged by the flat judge. Standard gf-flat-1, 128 texels a metre, 256 px cells.

audio.character: cartoon: boings, pops and slide whistles; bright and a little rubbery

mechanics.why: a stage at a time, collectables, a hit, cards picked between rooms. Suggestions only.
